meta.name: spark-optimization
meta.description: Optimize Apache Spark jobs with partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and memory tuning. Use when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.

copy.tagline: 优化大数据处理作业的性能与资源占用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的数据作业常因Spark性能问题而卡顿或烧钱。
copy.tagline_en: Speed up Spark jobs and lower resource usage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Spark pipelines and often face slow jobs or high resource bills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按这套模式帮你优化 Spark 作业:调整分区、缓存、shuffle 与内存配置,并给出改好的代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 Spark 作业变慢、内存或 executor 调优、数据倾斜等性能问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 Spark 作业跑得很慢,帮我看看怎么优化
say.note: 会从分区、shuffle、内存等方面给建议

say.text: 这个 groupBy 出现数据倾斜,怎么处理?
say.note: 会给出加盐或广播小表的方案

say.text: 帮我调一下 executor 内存和 shuffle partitions

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude applies Spark tuning patterns to your jobs: partitioning, caching, shuffle and memory settings, and returns revised code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention slow Spark jobs, memory or executor tuning, data skew, or shuffle issues.

say_en.text: My Spark job is slow, help me optimize it
say_en.note: Suggests partition, shuffle and memory fixes

say_en.text: This groupBy has data skew, how do I fix it?
say_en.note: Offers salting or broadcast join options

say_en.text: Tune my executor memory and shuffle partitions
